tipoProblema.movimiento_sin_conductor: Vehicle moving with no driver assigned

slaAyuda.vigente: Still within the target time set by its rule.
slaAyuda.por_vencer: Close to missing the target time.
slaAyuda.vencido: Past the target time set by its rule.
slaAyuda.sin_sla: This problem has no target time: nobody is measuring how long it takes to resolve.

ayuda.severidad_base: Starting point set by the severity of the rule that opened the problem.
ayuda.contexto_operativo: What the vehicle was doing when it was detected.
ayuda.urgencia: How long ago it was detected and how fast new signals arrive.
ayuda.recurrencia: How many times the same thing happened on this vehicle.
ayuda.criticidad_activo: Always adds 0: there is still no way to mark a vehicle as critical, so this factor cannot contribute points.
ayuda.impacto_potencial: What can happen if the problem is not handled.
ayuda.sla_restante: How much of the target time is left.

prioridadDesglose.aclaracionSuma: The breakdown explains where the priority comes from, but it may not add up exactly to the number in the header: some factors are recalculated when the problem is opened and are not stored.
prioridadDesglose.desfasaje: The factors add up to less than the stored priority: part of the calculation is redone when reading and was not recorded when the case was prioritised.

motivo.version_no_soportada: The condition format version is not supported.
motivo.combinador_no_soportado: Conditions can only be combined with "and": all of them must be met.
motivo.cantidad_de_condiciones_invalida: A rule needs between 1 and 10 conditions.
motivo.campo_desconocido: That field cannot be used in a condition.
motivo.operador_no_admitido: That operator cannot be used with that field.
motivo.tipo_de_valor_incompatible: The value does not have the type that field and operator expect.
motivo.umbral_minutos_invalido: Sustained minutes are required with "sustained for" and cannot be used with any other operator.
motivo.lista_in_invalida: The value list must have between 1 and 50 items, with no duplicates.
motivo.json_no_parseable: We could not read the condition.

centroError.transicionBloqueada: Moving problems between states is not enabled yet. This is not a temporary glitch: trying again gives the same result.
centroError.problemaCerrado: This problem is already closed, so the action cannot be applied. Refresh to see its current state.
centroError.condicionInvalida: Check the highlighted condition. Nothing was saved.
centroError.urlNoPermitida: Fix the URL: it must be https and point to a public server.
centroError.conflicto: Something changed while you were working. Refresh and choose again.
centroError.noEncontrado: We could not find it: it may no longer exist or may not belong to your organization.
centroError.sinPermiso: You do not have the permission required for this action.
centroError.moduloNoActivo: Your organization does not have the Fleet module active.
centroError.red: We could not reach the server. We do not know whether the change was saved: refresh before trying again.
centroError.generico: We could not complete the action.

centroBloqueado.cambiarEstado: Moving problems between statuses is not enabled yet: which transitions are allowed has not been defined, so no change can be saved. This is not a temporary failure — trying again gives the same result.
centroBloqueado.comentar: Commenting is not available yet: the note cannot be recorded in the problem history. Assigning, muting and resolving are recorded.
centroBloqueado.exportar: Exporting problems is not available yet.
centroBloqueado.filtros: Filtering and sorting this list is not available yet. The full list is shown, ordered by priority.
centroBloqueado.alcanceRegla: A rule cannot be narrowed down to specific vehicles, drivers or zones yet: this rule applies to the whole organization.
centroBloqueado.suscripciones: You cannot choose which events an endpoint subscribes to yet, so it will not receive automatic deliveries. You can send a manual test with "Test".
centroBloqueado.reintentarEntregas: Requeuing deliveries does not send them again yet: they would sit waiting without going out. That is why the action is unavailable.
centroBloqueado.ventanaDeGracia: When you rotate, the system starts signing with the new secret immediately and the previous one stops working. Coordinate the change with the receiver before rotating.
centroBloqueado.gestionarAlerta: Handling a signal is not available yet.
centroBloqueado.deteccionAlertas: Signal detection is not connected yet: none can be recorded for now. An empty list does not mean there is nothing to review.

campoAyuda.velocidad_kmh: Speed reported by the GPS in the last signal.
campoAyuda.ignicion: Whether the engine is on according to the last GPS signal.
campoAyuda.en_movimiento: Whether the vehicle is moving according to the last GPS signal.
campoAyuda.minutos_sin_senal: Minutes elapsed since the last signal from the device.
campoAyuda.bateria_pct: Device battery charge, as a percentage.
campoAyuda.manipulacion_detectada: No source fills this field in yet: a rule using it is saved but never triggers.
campoAyuda.dtc_criticidad: Criticality of the diagnostic case that raised the fault.
campoAyuda.dtc_codigo: Code reported by the vehicle computer, for example P0300.
campoAyuda.conductor_asignado: Whether the vehicle currently has an assigned driver.
campoAyuda.dias_para_vencer: Days left before a required document expires. It is only checked when a signal arrives from the vehicle: nothing monitors it on its own.
campoAyuda.documento_vencido: Whether a required document has expired. It is only checked when a signal arrives from the vehicle: nothing monitors it on its own.
campoAyuda.vehiculo_incompleto: Whether the vehicle is missing data. It is only checked when a signal arrives from the vehicle: nothing monitors it on its own.
campoAyuda.mantenimiento_vencido: Reported by the Operations module, which does not exist yet: until then this field is never true.

modal.subtitulo: Define which signal opens a problem, with what severity and within what target time.
modal.tipoAyuda: Where the signal evaluated by this rule comes from.
modal.tipoFijo: The type is set when the rule is created and cannot be changed afterwards.
modal.plazoAyuda: Time to resolve the problem. It is suggested by severity and you can change it.
modal.condicionAyuda: Every condition must be met for the rule to open a problem.
modal.umbralAyuda: Minutes the condition must hold without interruption. Signal history is not stored yet, so a sustained condition may never be met.
modal.minimoCondiciones: A rule needs at least one condition.
modal.maximoCondiciones: A rule allows up to {{maximo}} conditions.
modal.webhookAyuda: The rule stores the endpoint, but it does not notify it when it opens a problem yet: automatic delivery is not built. For now the only thing that produces a delivery is the "Test" button in Integrations.
modal.webhookSinPermiso: To choose a webhook you need the {{permiso}} permission. Whatever the rule already has stays as it is.
modal.webhookNoSeDesvincula: Switching back to "No webhook" does not unlink the current one yet: the rule keeps the same stored endpoint. Every other change is saved.
modal.accionSugeridaAyuda: What the person handling the problem should do. It is shown on the ticket.
modal.activaAyuda: A paused rule does not evaluate signals and does not open new problems.

integraciones.entregasDeTodaLaOrganizacion: The most recent deliveries across the whole organization are shown; the endpoint filter applies to what has already been loaded.

secreto.descripcion: This is the only time it is shown in full. Afterwards you will only see its prefix.
secreto.subtituloAlta: The webhook was created. This is the secret used to sign its deliveries.
secreto.subtituloRotacion: The secret was rotated. This is the new value deliveries will be signed with.
secreto.confirmacion: I saved the secret somewhere safe
secreto.errorCopiar: We could not copy it. Select it manually and copy it before closing: it cannot be requested again.

probar.aclaracion: Sends a signed test message to the real URL. A successful test does not mark the endpoint as healthy: it only adds one delivery to the history.
probar.resultadoAclaracion: This is the result of the test delivery. Receiving it does not mark the endpoint as healthy.

firma.descripcion: Every delivery is signed. The receiver must validate all three: the timestamp, the signature and the event id.
firma.headerSignature: The HMAC signature of the message body.
firma.headerEventId: Unique event identifier. Use it to discard duplicates.
firma.headerEventType: Event type, with its public name.
firma.headerTimestamp: Time of the delivery. Use it to reject replayed messages.
firma.rawBody: The body is signed exactly as it is transmitted, without re-serializing it. The v1= prefix is part of the header value.
firma.validacionTriple: The receiver must validate all three: that the timestamp is within tolerance, that the signature matches, and that the event id has not been processed before.
firma.sinEndpoint: Set up a webhook to see its fingerprint and rotate its secret.

eventos.aclaracionSinSuscripciones: This catalog describes the system events. An endpoint cannot subscribe to any of them yet.

silenciar.aclaracion: Muting starts now. It does not delete signals, does not stop detection and does not pause the target time: the problem can still go overdue.

resolver.aclaracionIntegracion: The closure is not sent to your integrations: that connection is not built yet.
